about.thesis: The person authors their own life. Root never authors it for them.
about.gistBody: Root is an ecosystem for knowing and growing yourself — no rush, no lock-in, no game played with your attention. It's young and grows slowly: today it works closely with a small number of people, and the rest of the family — Root Cast, Journey, Root Studio — arrives when it's ready, not before.
about.clientsBody: Track your contract, approve designs, and see what you owe — all in one quiet place.

home.title: A place to read, in more than one language
home.body: Research and writing Root translates, hosts and cites — original and translation side by side, each in its own script.
home.researchTitle: Papers, books and Root's own research
home.researchBody: Search the corpus, read an entry beside its translation, and see exactly what its rights allow.
